title: Zephyrine and the Confession
author: Odile Iversen
blurb: Emrys Winterbourne, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
